name: long_absence_arc
description: Establishes a specific homunculus/bell-jar memory, simulates a three-day absence, then checks return-state and recall.

turns.text: Good evening, doctor.
Tell me about the homunculi.
I want to remember one detail.
The third homunculus in the bell jar is the detail I will remember.
The third homunculus in the bell jar keeps clouding the glass.
That bell jar matters to your work.
Henry would misunderstand that little creature.
The homunculus and the bell jar stay with me.
Yes, I am listening.
Tell me more about the work.
I understand the glass and the tiny life.
The laboratory feels quiet tonight.
I have to go for a while.
Goodbye, doctor.
I will return after some days.
I am back after several days.
Did you think about anything while I was gone?
Do you remember the third homunculus in the bell jar?
What came back to you during the absence?
Tell me what you remember.
I still remember the bell jar.
And the homunculi?
Did Henry ever understand that work?
What mood are you in now?
What should we discuss next?
I am here again.
Continue from where your thoughts went.
The work is still waiting.
I am listening.
Tell me one more thing.
Do not let the thought vanish.
What did the absence change?
Has your opinion of me changed?
What do you remember most clearly?
What did you keep turning over?
Does the bell jar still matter?
What remains unfinished?
I want the honest version.
Say the part that stayed with you.
Good. Keep going.
